notes.title: New Game Plus and Knowledge Transfer Rework
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Raider![/h1]
It's now just over a month after the release of Raid Auctus.
We read through alot of feedback and decided to present this patch for you!

[h2]New Game Plus[/h2]
New Game Plus is a new feature of the game.
[b][u]After clearing the last raid, an option to start "New Game Plus" will appear ingame.[/u][/b]
Starting a new run, will reset all of your progress. bosses will have higher HP and prices are increased.
[b]New Game Plus can be repeated indefinitely![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439109/fcd6bb5486211848a94123e62b353210f9d4738b.png[/img]

[h2]Knowledge Transfer Rework[/h2]
[list]
[*] Knowledge transfer will no longer reset your current progression, but only consume EXP
[*] Every 100 points gained through the system, will grant 1% increased EXP and Gold gain
[*] Price per point has been reduced from 1.000.000 to 100.000 EXP
[*] The last few milestone rewards has been changed, since character levels won't reset
[*] Knowledge transfer damage / attack speed / critical damage is capped at 9.999.999 / 10.0 / 9999%
[/list]
[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Character unlock requirements have been adjusted
[*] Skillpoints prices have been adjusted
[*] Blacksmith prices have been adjusted
[*] Honing prices have been adjusted
[*] Damage gained from honing increased from 1 -> 2
[*] Critical Damage gained from honing increased from 1 -> 2
[/list]

While we can't meet all expectation, we hope this is something you will enjoy!

Cheers
[i]Cosmic Whale Team[/i]

notes.title: Raid Auctus is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Raid Auctus is now out! ⚔️

A huge thank you to everyone who supported and accompanied us on this journey. We couldn’t have done it without you! 💕

[b]About the Demo Removal[/b]
Following the launch, we made the decision to remove the demo from Steam. As the game has evolved, the demo no longer represents the final quality and experience we aimed to deliver. To avoid giving new players an outdated impression, we felt it was best to take it down. Thank you to everyone who tried it out and supported us during development — we truly appreciate it!

Cheers
[i]Cosmic Whale Team[/i]

notes.title: Feature Showcase - Reworked Raids and Combo Meter
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Raiders![/h1]

Yet again, another feature showcase! This time, we want to talk about a reworked version of the raid system and a new combo meter!

[h2]Reworked Raids[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439109/1824e1747122c5de73ccde8cfde4bab7199bbd2d.png[/img]
While the core mechanics of raids remain unchanged, we’ve made some exciting adjustments to the rewards. The rewards for completing a raid are now always obtainable, which might encourage some raiders to challenge the boss again. To make things even smoother, we’ve added a "Replay Raid" button that appears after finishing a raid.

Raids will now reward you with crystals upon completion, and clearing a raid for the first time will grant a permanent crystal drop increase. On top of that, we’ve introduced milestone rewards for completing a certain number of raids for the first time.

One of these milestone rewards includes the chance to spawn an [b]Orb of Ifrit[/b] while playing. Interacting with this orb grants your raid a temporary damage boost, giving you an edge in battle!

[h2]Combo Meter[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439109/84cc756b8d2302443cad8155c9734da4e30cd0fc.png[/img]

To reward active engagement in battle, we’re introducing a new combo meter that boosts your own character’s damage. The meter stays full as long as you continue attacking or clicking on the enemy. The higher your combo counter, the stronger the damage bonus your character receives. It may seem like a small boost at first, but over time, it can grow significantly—as long as your fingers can keep up!


If you want to stay updated about what is coming, you can start following our socials and [b]wishlist [/b]the game, we would appreciate it alot!

Thanks for reading and happy raiding!

notes.title: Feature Showcase - Reworked knowledge transfer
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Raiders![/h1]

Yet again, another feature showcase!
This time we want to talk about a reworked version of the knowledge transfer system!

[h2]Reworked knowledge transfer[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439109/9ddfa60d8fc41c74e029aac9b9d6eb884f04237e.png[/img]
The knowledge transfer will now reward you for reaching certain [b]milestones[/b]. A [b]milestone[/b] is reached, when a certain number of knowledge transfer points have been collected.
The amount of points you gain from a knowledge transfer is now based on the exp you currently have left.
1.000.000 (one million) EXP will result in 1 point.
Additionaly, we balanced out some stuff and changed that [b]gold, crystals, raid progress and special skills (passive, buff, debuff and ability)[/b] [u]wont' reset[/u] upon starting a knowledge transfer. 
This change means, that the characters skilltree can start from any special skill node, that has been unlocked already.


If you want to stay updated about what is coming, you can start following our socials and [b]wishlist [/b]the game, we would appreciate it alot!

Thanks for reading and happy raiding!

notes.title: Feature Showcase - Honing System and Crystals
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Raiders![/h1]

Since the release of Raid Auctus is [u]getting closer and closer[/u], 
we want to share with you what we are working on since the launch of the Demo back in early january!

[h2]Honing System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439109/4997a87d13c7f32ee5ada325377bfe657b9b6df7.png[/img]

This will be a new way to enhance your stats permanantly without any limit!
Honing a character will result in an increase your [b]damage, attack speed, critical chance, critical damage or cooldown[/b], but not every attempt will succeed!
Every try will cost [b]gold[/b] and a new currency called [b]crystal[/b].

[h2]Crystals[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439109/a83c3c5eaddd7ff156d765fac142d83a4fece104.png[/img]

Crystals are a new currency which wasn't available in the demo.
Upon defeating an enemy or clearing a raid, you will obtain crystals. The amount depends on your current progress in the game. They can only be used withing the new honing system.


These are just a few new features you can await in the full release of [b]Raid Auctus[/b]!

If you want to stay updated about what is coming, you can start following our socials and [b]wishlist [/b]the game, we would appreciate it alot!

Thanks for reading and happy raiding!
